records.rationale: Adds SPR/EPR AVS PDO bitfield decoding and debug logging. This describes physical adjustable charger capabilities; native PPS decoding/logging remains. No generic memory-safety fix is bundled. Do not add the new protocol helpers solely for future charging hardware. Full candidate patch read. Decision is restricted to the SDK emulator, whose goldfish product explicitly describes USB as unavailable and creates only an unused gadget for sysfs testing. Native generic Type-C support remains compiled; configuration alone is not an exclusion proof. No LTS code is changed or fix reversed. Physical platforms/forwarded physical Type-C topologies are outside this decision; runtime was not tested.

Adds read-only SPR AVS current/peak-current sysfs attributes and APDO registration. A positive consumer exists in the SDK-selected USB HAL: UsbPowerProfileMonitor::createPowerProfile parses these exact names. Its query path is feature-flag and enumerated-port dependent; the flag value and live port list were not measured. The current product explicitly lacks USB and creates an unused test gadget, so no AVS charging topology is supplied by this target. Keep native existing power-delivery classes; omission is target-scoped, not a claim that Android never reads these attributes. Full candidate patch read. Decision is restricted to the SDK emulator, whose goldfish product explicitly describes USB as unavailable and creates only an unused gadget for sysfs testing. Native generic Type-C support remains compiled; configuration alone is not an exclusion proof. No LTS code is changed or fix reversed. Physical platforms/forwarded physical Type-C topologies are outside this decision; runtime was not tested.

positive_consumer: goldfish generic.mk selects android.hardware.usb-service.example. Android.bp links Usb.cpp and libusbutils. queryVersionHelper calls the profile monitor; createPowerProfile recognizes SPR AVS and both exact current attribute names. Query is feature-flag and enumerated-port dependent; no claim that this consumer is absent.
target_evidence: goldfish generic.mk sets ro.adb.has_usb=0 with explicit emulator-no-USB explanation, and init.ranchu.rc creates an unused gadget for sysfs tests. Native tcpci requires an I2C controller and connector firmware child; UCSI ACPI/CCG/STM32 providers are disabled in build 155. Native TYPEC/TCPM/TCPCI/UCSI/DP/TBT cores are enabled and remain native. Decision is source-based current product topology, not hardware enumeration or runtime proof.
security: Whole affected files remain LTS. Native UCSI teardown and later lock-class ordering fixes, current TCPM parsing/locking/timeouts and native alternate-mode lifecycle retained. The extra ACK cable/VDO checks are acknowledged target-specific omissions, not falsely labeled upstream-equivalent. Reevaluate before any physical Type-C platform.
validation: All 21 original patches read in full; exact whole-file/mutual-absence comparisons against LTS. No source changed; build 155 still represents implementation. No additional runtime or electrical/protocol test.
